title: Isigulana Esingagungqiyo
intro: Kwiingxelo zembali yesiprofeto, bambalwa abaye banyamezela ilahleko enkulu kangaka kunye neentlungu zomzimba ngokholo olungenakushukunyiswa. Ibali lalo mntu lisifundo esingapheliyo somonde nokuthembela kubulumko bukaThixo. Ngubani lo mphefumlo?
clues: Ndakhethwa nguAllah ukuba ndihambise umyalezo, kodwa uvavanyo lwam olukhulu aluzange lufike ngokulahlwa, kodwa lufike kwintlekele yam.
Ubutyebi bam, imfuyo yam, nabantwana bam bathathwa kum, omnye emva komnye.
Umzimba wam wawugcwele izilonda, ndaza ndashiywa ndedwa ngaphandle kwenkxaso yomyeni wam.
Ndakhala eNkosini yam, ndivuma ukubandezeleka kwam kwaye ndifuna inceba Yayo.
Ndayalelwa ukuba ndibethe umhlaba ngonyawo lwam, kwaza kwaphuma umthombo ohlaziyayo.
U-Allah undibuyisele impilo yam waza wandinika usapho olutsha nobutyebi obungaphezulu kunangaphambili.
arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
